run_display_urdf_cli: run the CLI to load a URDF XML file and print the parsed robot object
run_display_urdf_to_xml: run the CLI with the -o flag to dump a URDF file back to XML output
summarize_main: summarize the main function that parses a URDF file via argparse and prints the robot
review_urdf_from_xml_string: review the URDF.from_xml_string method used to parse a URDF XML string into a Robot object
review_urdf_to_xml_string: review the robot.to_xml_string method used to serialize a parsed URDF Robot back to XML
